name: Signature Green Corporation Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1982, Signature Green Corporation Ltd manufactures vegetable
oils from soybean and other oil seeds and
oil cakes by solvent extraction process[1]
keyPoints:
Business Expansion & Rebranding:[1][2]
a) Current Operations:
The company is in manufacturing, distribution, and sale of soybeans, vegetable oils, and related products. It is also in trading in agro-commodity.
b) Limitation: **
The company feels that the word ‘SOYA’ in its name restricts business to soybean-related products.
c) Diversification Plan: **
It has planned to expand into dealing in various food products.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.09 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 4.07% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -8.28%
